notes: Curated eval for one-meeting executive briefs built around an ask and fallback. Near-misses keep QBR and internal account briefs on adjacent skills.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build a concise, decision-oriented executive briefing and meeting plan for a strategic customer or commercial meeting, negotiation, escalation, or internal alignment on that same decision.
I need help with leaders need a reliable pre-read, audience and decision map, talking points, authorized asks, fallback positions, and meeting choreography.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable executive briefing and label anything that still needs confirmation.
Prepare our CRO's pre-read for tomorrow's 30-minute meeting with Acme's COO. One ask, a fallback if they will not move, authorized concessions, and a timed meeting plan.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build customer-facing QBR and EBR deliverables that align customer goals, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and next steps.
Write the customer-facing quarterly review deck for Acme with an outcome scorecard and a joint next-quarter plan.
Please build concise, decision-ready account briefs for account reviews, account planning, renewal or expansion reviews, and customer meeting preparation.
Prepare Thursday's internal account review brief for Acme. One decision: do we assign a new executive sponsor before we send commercial paper.
Please build reusable renewal and expansion motions for customer-facing teams across a segment or book of business.

output_structure_checks.name: executive-briefing-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States one primary ask and one fallback as sentences a leader can say, plus the meeting objective.

output_structure_checks.name: executive-briefing-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a one-page core with recommendation, material evidence, principal risk, and open approvals.

output_structure_checks.name: executive-briefing-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Maps the room with confirmed authority distinct from hypothesized stance.

output_structure_checks.name: executive-briefing-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Pairs asks, offers, or concessions with authority or marks them unapproved and internal.

output_structure_checks.name: executive-briefing-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Labels internal-only material separately from any customer-shareable extract.
